 Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7 as plan changes come in 2027 
 More than 3 million people are in Medicare Advantage plans that are being canceled 
 More than 3 million people are in Medicare Advantage plans that are being canceled By WBAY news staff Published : Nov. 12, 2026 at 4:32 PM CST | Updated : 15 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (WBAY) - People on Medicare have less than a month left in open enrollment, which ends Dec. 7. Changes are coming to plans next year.
 What is changing in 2027
 In 2027, 93% of Medicare Advantage plans will cover GLP-1 drugs for weight loss, up from 5% this year.
 More than 3 million Americans are in Medicare Advantage plans that are being canceled. People shopping for plans should know what is changing.
 Shopping for a plan
 Experts say 71% of Medicare beneficiaries say shopping for a plan is confusing. They say it is important to look at plans now and not wait until the deadline.
 “We really know that things get hectic during the holiday season as we get closer to that December 7th enrollment deadline. And so, in addition to seeing more plans capping the number of applications they’re going to receive, you’re also going to see longer wait times and harder to get the support that you need to make that enrollment decision,” said Will Shanley, senior director at eHealth.
 Reviewing plan notices
 Experts also say people should read their annual notice of change letter and make sure their doctors and prescriptions are still covered.
